sentences.en: The old kettle [[hummed]] on the stove all morning.
sentences.cs: Stará konvice celé dopoledne [[bzučela]] na sporáku.

sentences.en: Somewhere down the hall a pipe [[hummed]] again.
sentences.cs: Někde dole na chodbě zase [[bzučela]] trubka.

sentences.en: Nobody noticed that the radio [[hummed]] quietly.
sentences.cs: Nikdo si nevšiml, že rádio tiše [[bzučela]].
